restartDesc.zh: 账号菜单里的重启入口；桌面版关闭并重新打开整个应用
restartDesc.en: The restart entry in the account menu; the desktop app closes and reopens entirely

confirmBody.zh: 桌面版会关闭并重新打开整个应用，正在进行的任务会中断（会话历史已保存）。
confirmBody.en: The desktop app closes and reopens entirely; running tasks are interrupted (session history is saved).

restartingDesc.zh: 正在重新拉起后台进程，请稍候…
restartingDesc.en: Bringing the background process back up, please wait…

timeout.zh: 重启超时：请查看 .debug/restart/ 下的重启日志，或手动重新打开
timeout.en: Restart timed out: check the restart log under .debug/restart/, or reopen the app manually

troubleUnreached.zh: 重启服务没有响应（请求未到达宿主）
troubleUnreached.en: The restart service did not answer (the request never reached the host)

troubleRefused.en: The restart service refused the request (HTTP {status})

troubleMalformed.zh: 重启服务的回答无法识别
troubleMalformed.en: The restart service's answer could not be read
